Sort geometries along a curve

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometries | `G` | Geometry | List |  | Geometries to sort |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to sort along |
